records.region: Western Puna, northern mountain feeder and receiving saline depression in the Jujuy–Salta border region
records.naming_scope_hold_reason: The original photographic evidence establishes the connected physical corridor but carries no hydronym labels. Two independent publications supply only regional basin and neighboring river context. The optional scientific article map could not be inspected. The regional river-name list cannot uniquely assign a name to this selected western branch or turn its salar-floor continuation into a uniformly named river.
records.geographic_disambiguation: All17 parts have complete ordinary geographic correspondence from a broad northern alluvial opening through the western mountain valley, its southern fan and saline margin, and across the receiving salar floor. Inspected imagery has no hydronym labels, and the read regional prose does not spatially name the selected river. Completed null-name scope hold; optional source-access limits are separate.
records.completion_scope: Complete connected alluvial/valley floor, fan, saline-margin and salar-floor correspondence, including every original part and join and both separately preserved coincident terminal fields. No current wet thread is required. No supported representative river-system name, accepted scalar name, Korean name, formal registry verification or application.
records.supported_name_scope: The original photographic evidence establishes the connected physical corridor but carries no hydronym labels. scope_limits: No inspected labelled map establishes a representative river-system name or bounded selected-river hydronym. Regional prose and discovery excerpts do not replace this missing naming correspondence.
The northern opening is broad low alluvium; the long valley and lower fan are connected at ordinary landscape scale rather than by every vertex following a current wet thread.

The selected saline-floor bends and terminal are a coarse rendered continuation across one receiving floor. Present surface flow, salt-lake level, precise bank or shoreline, infiltration and mining operation are not verified.

Scattered cloud/shadow patches are outside the necessary upper selected valley. The material corridor, fan and terminal floor are visible; no hidden connector is supplied by inference through a cloud.

bounded_name_observations.scope: Regional names in independently read prose only. Huaytiquina and Huaitiquina are preserved as the respective sources print them; no formal equivalence, selected reach identity or whole-feature river name is promoted.

reconstruction_rule: Start from the pinned r46 cumulative index and apply later append-only deltas in verified commit order, rejecting duplicate IDs. Keep base records, scope clauses, region qualifiers and assessment histories unchanged. Apply explicit status-list changes. publication_boundary: Own factual name/scope findings, public official URLs, bounded geometry metadata and public continuity pins only. No original maps, crops, complete coordinates or private source/derivative/registration fingerprints. Official hosting does not establish source redistribution rights.

research_order.progress_rule: Follow the actual continental order: Americas, Asia, Africa, Europe, then other, with all rivers before lakes. Preserve original queue IDs and ranks for continuity; apply documented geographic deferrals without counting them as name research, and place deferred objects into their corrected later phase by length-descending, stable-ID order. Prior candidate and scope-held assessments remain unresolved where stated.
